'''Sakiyan shadowsuits''' were a type of [[shadowsuit]] body glove used by members of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Unlike other shadowsuits, which were woven from artificial [[Shadowsilk/Legends|shadowsilk]], Sakiyan shadowsuits were made with the [[Silk of the umbraspider/Legends|silk]] of the [[Umbraspider/Legends|umbraspider]], which they considered to be superior. The shadowsuits refracted and absorbed light, which meant that it was nearly impossible to see the wearer without a very bright light. A shadowsuit retailed for 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sakiyan shadowsuit first appeared in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
